III. PUBLIC COMMENT

a. Members of the public may testify in person or virtually. Multnomah County staff will be available in room 126 on Thursdays during the Boardroom closure for community members who cannot provide testimony virtually. Public comment on non-agenda items will be heard at the beginning of Thursday board meetings. Comments on agenda items are heard before the Board votes on that item. Depending upon time constraints, public comment may be limited both in number of speakers and in time to testify. The deadline to sign up for the next scheduled Thursday Board meeting is Wednesday at 4 p.m.

b. To testify: Please use the public testimony form to sign up to testify or to submit written testimony on agenda and non-agenda items. There are a limited amount of speaking slots available for public testimony on non-agenda items for each Board meeting. If non-agenda testimony slots are full, you may still submit written testimony or sign up to give testimony for actionable items on the regular agenda.

c. The deadline to sign up for the next scheduled Thursday Board meeting is Wednesday at 4 p.m.
